info.name: CalisHealth - Calisthenics Level Benchmark Criteria
info.description: Postman checks for the Content Manager 'Level & Benchmark Criteria' screens: list (with 3-dot actions), level detail and Update All Benchmark Levels (where levels are added with the Add level button; there is no separate Create screen). Set cmEmail/cmPassword (a CONTENT_MANAGER account) and run the whole collection in order with the Runner. Folder 1 saves a snapshot of the current levels and thresholds; folder 2 ends by adding a level called 'Postman Temp Level' that folders 3 and 4 use and delete; folder 5 restores the snapshot. Run it against a local/dev database, not production.
